metadata.title: Set up worker profile | Slashie
metadata.description: Create your Slashie worker profile with skills, bio, portfolio, and service details.

en.title: Set up your worker profile
en.description: Add the essentials customers need before they choose your quote.
en.loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again. Anything you saved is still there.
en.completeTitle: You're set up as a worker

profile.details.title: Tell us your name
profile.details.description: About 5 minutes. You'll need your date of birth, a photo, a short bio, your skills, your area and a phone to verify. Travel distance and portfolio are optional.

profile.photo.title: Add a profile photo
profile.photo.description: A clear, friendly photo helps customers choose you. We also ask for your date of birth.

profile.bio.title: Write a headline and short bio
profile.bio.description: Customers read this before they accept your quote. Two or three sentences about the work you do best.

services.skills.title: What work do you do?
services.skills.description: Your skills decide which tasks you show up for.

services.experience.title: How much experience do you have?
services.experience.description: Shown next to your rating on your profile.

area.location.title: Where do you work?
area.location.description: Customers only see an approximate area, never your address.

area.travel.title: How far will you travel?
area.travel.description: Optional. A wider radius shows you more tasks.

verify.phone.title: Verify your phone
verify.phone.description: You need a verified phone to send quotes. Customers see a Phone verified badge on your profile.

verify.portfolio.title: Show your work
verify.portfolio.description: Optional. Photos of finished jobs help you win more quotes.

review.submit.title: Your profile, as customers see it
review.submit.description: Check the preview below, then start quoting.

metadata.title: 設定工作者個人檔案 | Slashie
metadata.description: 建立你的 Slashie 工作者個人檔案，加入技能、簡介、作品和服務詳情。

zh_hk.title: 設定你的工作者個人檔案
zh_hk.description: 加入顧客選擇你的報價前需要知道的重點。
zh_hk.loadErrorBody: 請檢查網絡連線後再試。你已儲存的內容仍然保留。

profile.details.title: 你的名字
profile.details.description: 大約需時 5 分鐘。你需要提供出生日期、頭像、簡短自我介紹、技能、服務地區，以及驗證電話號碼。服務距離及作品集可選填。

profile.photo.title: 加入個人頭像
profile.photo.description: 清晰友善的頭像有助顧客選擇你。我們亦需要你的出生日期。

profile.bio.title: 撰寫標題及簡介
profile.bio.description: 顧客接受你的報價前會先看這部分。用兩三句介紹你最擅長的工作。

services.skills.title: 你做哪類工作？
services.skills.description: 你的技能決定你會看到哪些任務。

services.experience.title: 你有多少年經驗？
services.experience.description: 會顯示在你個人檔案的評分旁邊。

area.location.title: 你在哪裡工作？
area.location.description: 顧客只會看到大概地區，絕不會看到你的地址。

area.travel.title: 你願意走多遠？
area.travel.description: 可選填。範圍越大，你會看到越多任務。

verify.phone.title: 驗證你的電話
verify.phone.description: 你需要已驗證的電話才能傳送報價。顧客會在你的個人檔案看到「電話已驗證」標記。

verify.portfolio.title: 展示你的作品
verify.portfolio.description: 可選填。完成工作的相片有助你贏得更多報價。

review.submit.title: 顧客眼中的你
review.submit.description: 檢查以下預覽，然後開始報價。
